properties.name: BequestArticleReference
properties.label: Reference in Will; format as <accent red>*Article 3.2*</accent>

properties.name: BequestIsCommunityPropertyTF
properties.label: Bequest is of community property (i.e. bequest is for Decedent's 1/2 interest)

properties.name: BequestEqualTF
properties.label: The bequest is in **equal portions** or to **one recipient**

properties.name: BequestRecipients
properties.label: {[if !BequestRecipients]}<accent red>**REQUIRED**</accent>   {[endif]}Enter the recipient(s){[if ShowPercentageTF]} and their portions{[endif]}

properties.name: BequestSelectProperty
properties.label: {[if !BequestSelectProperty]}<accent red>**REQUIRED**</accent>   {[endif]}Select the property item(s) in this bequest:

properties.name: BequestType
properties.label: {[if !BequestType]}<accent red>**REQUIRED**</accent>   {[endif]}Is bequest in usufruct, trust, or outright?

properties.name: BequestCustomUsufructTerm
properties.label: Describe the custom term, i.e. "until the grass on the marital home reaches over six inches in length".

properties.name: BequestUsufructTerm
properties.label: What is the term of the usufruct?
properties.helpText: A usufruct may be for life, or it may terminate upon remarriage or some other event.
properties.options: [{"Name":"For life","Label":"For life"},{"Name":"Terminate on remarriage","Label":"Terminate on remarriage"},{"Name":"Years","Label":"For a certain number of years"},{"Name":"Custom","Label":"Custom term"}]

properties.name: BequestUsufructYears
properties.label: Number of years the usufruct should last

properties.name: BequestUsufructDispensationTF
properties.label: Check the box if the usufructuary has the "right of dispensation."
properties.helpText: The usufruct may with "with" or "without" the right of dispensation, which is the right to sell property subject to the usufruct, such as real estate. Without the right of dispensation, the naked owners will have to consent in writing to certain sales.

properties.name: BequestUsufructBondTF
properties.label: Check the box if the usufruct is WITHOUT bond.
properties.helpText: Bond may be waived in a testament, in which case the usufructuary will not be required to post bond or security that may be required by Louisiana law?

properties.name: BequestSelectCommunity
properties.label: Select the **community property** item(s) in this bequest, if any:

properties.name: BequestSelectSeparate
properties.label: {[if !MarriedTF && !BequestSelectSeparate]}<accent red>**REQUIRED**</accent>   {[endif]}Select the {[if MarriedTF]}**separate* {[endif]}property** item(s) in this bequest{[if MarriedTF]}, if any{[endif]}:

formulas.name: BequestPetitioners
formulas.expression:
["BequestType == "Usufruct"
   ? (BequestNakedOwners|map: {id$: "Owner"+this.id$, 
      PetitionerName: this.NameCO,
      PetitionerRole: "individual",
      PetitionerParish: this.PartyParish,
      PetitionerParishCounty: this.PartyParishCounty,
      PetitionerState: this.PartyState,
      PetitionerGenderHisHer: (this.Gender.HisHer|else: "his or her"),
      PetitionerRelationship: this.PartyDecedentRelate,
      PetitionerBlockAddress: this.PartyBlockAddress
      })
   : BequestType == "Trust"
      ? (BequestTrustees1|map: {id$: "Trustee"+this.id$, 
      PetitionerName: this.NameCO,
      PetitionerRole: "trustee",
      PetitionerParish: this.PartyParish,
      PetitionerParishCounty: this.PartyParishCounty,
      PetitionerState: this.PartyState,
      PetitionerGenderHisHer: (this.Gender.HisHer|else: "his or her"),
      PetitionerRelationship: this.PartyDecedentRelate,
      PetitionerBlockAddress: this.PartyBlockAddress})
      : (BequestRecipients|map: {id$: "Recipient"+this.id$, 
      PetitionerName: SelectBequestRecipient.NameCO,
      PetitionerRole: "individual",
      PetitionerParish: SelectBequestRecipient.PartyParish,
      PetitionerParishCounty: SelectBequestRecipient.PartyParishCounty,
      PetitionerState: SelectBequestRecipient.PartyState,
      PetitionerGenderHisHer: (SelectBequestRecipient.Gender.HisHer|else: "his or her"),
      PetitionerRelationship: SelectBequestRecipient.PartyDecedentRelate,
      PetitionerBlockAddress: SelectBequestRecipient.PartyBlockAddress
      })"]
